applicability: Code Chest's optional companion integration when Code Chest and a compatible Spellbook are active. Current tools and native permissions determine whether a saved-code review or native code draft can be edited.

useCases.title: Style or customize a form
useCases.appliesWhen: The user wants form-specific styling or JavaScript behavior.
useCases.detail: Code Chest stores form-specific CSS and JavaScript. Its assistant companion reads existing code and prepares reviewed replacements from supported assistant pages. PHP is not supported.

prerequisites.title: Use the current page's code tools
prerequisites.appliesWhen: Choosing how to make a Code Chest change.
prerequisites.detail: When code_chest_read_saved_code and code_chest_prepare_saved_code are listed, inspect saved code and prepare a Save code changes review from this page. In the native Code Chest editor, use draft tools for its current form; saved tools may target other forms without replacing that unsaved work. Open Code Chest is optional navigation; absent field/form configuration schemas do not establish that code editing is unavailable.

qualifications.title: Review before saving
qualifications.appliesWhen: Preparing or applying a Code Chest code change.
qualifications.detail: Read current code before proposing changes. A saved-code review requires an explicit Save code changes click and rejects stale code. Saved CSS/JavaScript affect later form renders, even if the native code feed is inactive. A native editor draft proposal only changes unsaved inputs; Save Settings persists that draft. Neither path tests the code or supplies an unsaved frontend preview.
